boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten verified UCI and Irvine places for studying, browsing art, and taking a low-key walk without admission.

cards.title: Walk through University Art Gallery
cards.subtitle: Claire Trevor School of the Arts, UCI
cards.notes: Meet by the gallery entrance, take a self-guided lap, then compare one work each before heading to the next nearby gallery.
cards.short_summary: A free art stop in the Arts Plaza galleries.
cards.evidence_claim: University Art Gallery is one of UCI's University Art Galleries, where admission is free.
cards.source_title: Visit | University Art Galleries | Department of Art | Claire Trevor School of the Arts
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday–Saturday, noon–6 p.m.; hours are subject to change. Campus parking requires a permit.

cards.title: Browse the CAC Gallery
cards.subtitle: Contemporary Arts Center, UCI
cards.notes: Use this gallery as a calm conversation stop: look independently first, then regroup and trade observations about the exhibition.
cards.short_summary: Free contemporary-art viewing at the Claire Trevor School of the Arts.
cards.evidence_claim: Contemporary Arts Center Gallery is part of UCI's University Art Galleries, whose admission is free.
cards.source_title: Visit | University Art Galleries | Department of Art | Claire Trevor School of the Arts
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday–Saturday, noon–6 p.m.; hours are subject to change. Campus parking requires a permit.

cards.title: Visit Room Gallery
cards.subtitle: Art Culture and Technology Building, UCI
cards.notes: Pair a quick Room Gallery visit with a short walk around the arts buildings, leaving time to read wall text or artist materials.
cards.short_summary: A free gallery stop in UCI's Art Culture and Technology building.
cards.evidence_claim: Room Gallery is part of UCI's University Art Galleries, whose admission is free.
cards.source_title: Visit | University Art Galleries | Department of Art | Claire Trevor School of the Arts
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday–Saturday, noon–6 p.m.; hours are subject to change. Campus parking requires a permit.

cards.entity_name: UC Irvine Langson Orange County Museum of Art
cards.title: See California art at Langson IMCA
cards.subtitle: 18881 Von Karman Avenue, Irvine
cards.notes: Plan a shared museum circuit through the current galleries, then pause in the reading lounge to talk about a work that caught your eye.
cards.short_summary: Free public museum admission in Irvine.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Irvine Langson Orange County Museum of Art states that admission is always free.
cards.source_title: UC Irvine Langson Orange County Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: The museum lists Tuesday–Saturday, 10 a.m.–4 p.m.; confirm current exhibitions before going.

cards.title: Settle into Langson Library
cards.subtitle: UCI main campus
cards.notes: Bring a friend for a quiet work session, browse a shelf between tasks, or use the on-site collections before taking a study break.
cards.short_summary: On-site library use is available at no cost.
cards.evidence_claim: UCI Libraries identifies Langson Library as a campus library and says on-site books, journals, newspapers, and other resources are available at no cost.
cards.source_title: Suggestions for Successful Visits | UC Irvine Libraries
cards.access_notes: The library welcomes the general public; parking, printing, and photocopying have fees. Check current building hours.

cards.title: Browse Science Library together
cards.subtitle: UCI main campus
cards.notes: Choose a table for a low-cost study hang, then browse science titles or periodicals on-site when you need a focused break.
cards.short_summary: Free on-site access to a UCI library's resources.
cards.evidence_claim: UCI Libraries identifies Science Library as a campus library and says on-site books, journals, newspapers, and other resources are available at no cost.
cards.source_title: Suggestions for Successful Visits | UC Irvine Libraries
cards.access_notes: The library welcomes the general public; parking, printing, and photocopying have fees. Check current building hours.

cards.title: Request archival material on-site
cards.subtitle: UC Irvine Libraries
cards.notes: Pick a local-history or campus-history question together, then ask library staff how to consult relevant archival materials in person.
cards.short_summary: Explore UCI archival materials without an admission charge.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Irvine Libraries says special collections and archival materials are available for on-site use at no cost.
cards.source_title: Suggestions for Successful Visits | UC Irvine Libraries
cards.access_notes: Use is on-site; ask staff about handling and access procedures. Parking, printing, and photocopying may cost extra.

cards.title: Take a self-guided library exhibit lap
cards.subtitle: UC Irvine Libraries
cards.notes: Choose an exhibit location, read the introductory panel, and give each person time to find one detail worth discussing afterward.
cards.short_summary: Public, self-guided library exhibits with no admission charge.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Irvine Libraries exhibits are self-guided, open to the public, and available at no cost during regular library hours.
cards.source_title: Exhibit Visitor Information | UCI Exhibits Site
cards.access_notes: Available during regular library hours; check the exhibit site for current locations and dates. Campus parking requires a permit.

cards.title: Research side by side on a library computer
cards.subtitle: UC Irvine Libraries
cards.notes: Use an on-site computer to look up a topic, scan a short source, and share a few useful finds without needing to buy anything.
cards.short_summary: No-cost on-site computer access for visitors.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Irvine Libraries says computers with internet access are available for on-site use at no cost.
cards.source_title: Suggestions for Successful Visits | UC Irvine Libraries
cards.access_notes: Visitor Wi-Fi access is limited; computers are listed as available on-site at no cost. Check building hours before visiting.

cards.title: Walk the UCI Arboretum gardens
cards.subtitle: UCI North Campus, near Campus Drive and Jamboree Road
cards.notes: Take the paths at an unhurried pace and use the plant collections as prompts for photos, sketches, or a quiet outdoor catch-up.
cards.short_summary: A botanical-garden walk with documented free admission.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Irvine reported that admission and parking at the UCI Arboretum are free.
cards.source_title: Arboretum is no garden-variety greenhouse – UC Irvine News
cards.access_notes: The Arboretum's access and open days can change; verify its current public hours before making the trip.
